items.t: Air suspension leaks, sags or sits lopsided
items.job: Replace leaking air springs (pair) and air filter
items.note: Aftermarket springs cost far less than genuine. A compressor or height sensor adds a few hundred dollars each.

items.t: Coolant loss from slipped cylinder liner
items.job: Replace engine with rebuilt short block (top-hat liners)
items.note: Many owners choose a used or rebuilt engine instead.

items.t: Head gasket leak
items.job: Replace both head gaskets

items.t: Body control module (BECM) faults
items.job: Repair or replace body control module (BECM) and program

items.t: Heater blend motors fail
items.job: Replace heater blend motors (dash removal)

items.t: Heater core O-ring leak into driver footwell
items.job: Replace heater core pipe O-rings

items.t: Cracked flex-plate and loss of drive
items.job: Replace flex-plate (transmission removal) and mounting bushings

items.t: Center differential viscous coupling wears out
items.job: Replace transfer case viscous coupling

items.t: Underhood coolant and fluid leaks can start a fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Water in transmission fluid can stop Park from holding (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Air suspension sags overnight or shows a fault
items.job: Replace leaking air springs (pair) or air compressor

items.t: Timing chain guides wear and rattle
items.job: Replace timing chain guides, chain and tensioner
items.note: Often costs more than an older truck is worth.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: A Canadian shop quotes about $4,500-$7,500 CAD for a full timing service.

items.t: Supercharger coolant pump runs backwards
items.job: Replace auxiliary coolant pump and correct wiring

items.t: Transmission shifts badly or overheats
items.job: Replace radiator and service transmission fluid
items.note: A failed transmission costs several thousand dollars more.

items.t: Rear locking differential fault (P186D)
items.job: Replace rear differential motor and update software

items.t: Water leaks into the cabin
items.job: Clear or reconnect sunroof drain tubes and reseal door water shields

items.t: Rear suspension clunks over bumps
items.job: Replace rear hub carrier bushings and align

items.t: Water pump failure and coolant leaks
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant

items.t: Front driveshaft splines can wear and lose drive (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Front brake hoses can rupture (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Takata passenger airbag can rupture (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Coolant crossover pipe leaks
items.job: Replace coolant crossover pipes (intake or supercharger removal)
items.note: A Canadian shop quotes about $1,800-$3,200 CAD.

items.t: Supercharger coupler rattle at idle
items.job: Replace supercharger isolator coupler
items.note: A full snout rebuild costs about $2,000-$2,800 CAD.

items.t: Oil and transmission cooler lines corrode and leak
items.job: Replace oil or transmission cooler lines

items.t: Diesel breather oil leaks
items.job: Fit modified engine breather pipe
items.note: A UK review puts this at up to about £850.

items.t: Rotary gear selector doesn't rise
items.job: Replace rotary gear selector module

items.t: Doors can look shut but be unlatched (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Front suspension knuckle can crack (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Surround-view rear camera fills with water (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: DC-DC converter overload can cut power (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Blocked cam carrier oil channel can cause oil leak (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Rearview camera fogs or blanks from trapped water (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Driver airbag clockspring connector can corrode (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer

items.t: Panoramic sunroof side trim can come off (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Land Rover dealer
